title: TitanItemEditor
description: "A powerful in-game tool for managing and editing item properties, NBT data, lore, and names with an intuitive interface."
body:
TitanItemEditor

TitanItemEditor is a high-performance utility plugin designed for server administrators and developers to modify items directly in-game. Say goodbye to external NBT editors—edit your gear, tools, and custom items with a sleek, intuitive interface.
🚀 Key Features

    In-Game Editor: Modify item properties without restarting your server.

    NBT Management: View and edit complex NBT data tags with ease.

    Lore & Display Names: Quickly update item names and lore descriptions.

    Enchantment Support: Add, remove, or modify enchantments on any held item.

    Lightweight: Optimized for performance to ensure zero impact on your server's TPS.

🛠️ How to Use

    Install the plugin in your plugins folder.

    Restart your server.

    Use the command /editwand to get the wand and get an item in your offhand to open the menu with right-click
    Customize your item properties and save your changes!

⚙️ Commands & Permissions

    /editwand - to get the edit wand

    titan.edit - Permission required to use the item editor.

📦 Requirements

    Paper / Spigot  (1.21 +)

    No dependencies required!
